name: Online Reader
description: The online reader extension is designed to provide accessibility functions for reading books on the web.  It currently includes autoscrolling functionality.

startScrolling.description: Start scrolling at the current saved speed.

startAutoScrolling.description: Start persistent scrolling at the current saved speed.  It will continue to scroll upon page refresh or change as long as it remains on a registered site.

registerSite.description: Registers the current site with the reader extension.
